publications.title: Delineation of commonly deleted chromosomal regions in meningiomas by high-density single nucleotide polymorphism genotyping arrays.

corresponding_author: Maria D Tabernero, Jose A Orfao
institution: Hospital Universitario de Salamanca y Centro del Cáncer
platform: Affymetrix Mapping 250K Nsp SNP Array (GPL3718), Affymetrix Mapping 250K Sty2 SNP Array (GPL3720), Affymetrix Genome-Wide Human SNP 6.0 Array (GPL6801)

needs_manual_review_reason: Series-level GEO metadata verified directly against the live source; per-sample clinical/pathology fields not yet extracted from individual GSM records. FACT-CHECK UPDATE (2026-07-10): date_deposited/date_updated filled in from Series_submission_date/Series_last_update_date, previously 'Not reported'. platform expanded with full instrument names for GPL3718/GPL3720/GPL6801. Note on sample_count: the live GEO record's total Series_sample_id count is 214 (100 tumor + 100 matched-blood 500K-array pairs, plus 7 tumor + 7 matched-blood SNP6.0-array pairs), but sample_count here (50) intentionally reflects only the meningioma tumor samples, matching the series summary's own headline figure ('Cytogenetic profiles of 50 meningiomas'); the paired peripheral-blood germline-reference samples are not tumor tissue and are excluded from this count. FACT-CHECK UPDATE (2026-07-11): patient_count filled in as 50 (previously 'Not reported'), confirmed via NCBI esummary (db=gds) sample-title enumeration: all 214 GSM titles follow the pattern 'Sample#N ...', with N ranging over exactly 50 distinct integers (1-50), each patient contributing one tumor specimen (assayed via 2 arrays on the 500K platform or 1 SNP6.0 array, plus a matched blood sample on the same platform(s)); tumor-sample title count (107, matching the summary's 100+7) also confirmed against this same 50-patient set. FACT-CHECK UPDATE (2026-07-12): all 214 GSM records carry per-sample 'who grade', 'gender', and 'age' fields. Deduplicated by patient (Sample#N title), the 50 tumors break down as WHO grade I=45, II=3, III=2; grade_breakdown populated accordingly and tags.grade_comparable set true (all three grades explicitly represented). sex_distribution populated (39 female, 11 male across the 50 tumors) and age_distribution populated (range 26-84 years). who_edition left 'Not reported' since no WHO classification edition is stated in the source (grades given only as I/II/III). DEEP-AUDIT (2026-07-14): both publications' author lists were truncated to 6 names each (Europe PMC authorString confirms 13 for PMID 22371336 and 9 for PMID 24536048); both expanded to full. corresponding_author 'Maria D Tabernero, Jose A Orfao' NOT changed -- genuine attempt made but inconclusive: (1) Tabernero et al. 2012 (GCC, PMID 22371336) has no PMC copy and is paywalled at Wiley (onlinelibrary.wiley.com returned HTTP 403, and Europe PMC confirms isOpenAccess:N/inEPMC:N for this PMID), so its actual correspondence footnote could not be read directly; PubMed's abstract page suggests Tabernero alone (mdtabernero@iecscyl.com) but that is affiliation-list position, not a quoted footnote, and a web search snippet separately described Alberto Orfao as 'one of the corresponding authors' -- these two weak, conflicting secondary signals do not meet this project's bar for changing the field. (2) Domingues et al. 2014 (Neuro-oncology, PMID 24536048) full text (PMC3984558) WAS accessible and gives a single corresponding author, 'Maria Dolores Tabernero Redondo... (taberner@usal.es)', with no mention of Orfao as corresponding -- this alone doesn't justify dropping Orfao since the field is meant to cover both linked publications and the 2012 paper (where Orfao is last/senior author) remains unverified. Per instructions, left unchanged rather than guessed. Separately, cohort-linkage check: Domingues 2014's own cohort (302 primary + 132 validation patients, of which 50 SNP-array cases were 'pooled from our institution') is NOT the same as this GSE42624 series (50 patients) -- the paper does not explicitly equate its 50-case validation subset to the Tabernero 2012 cohort, so its reported outcome/relapse figures (from the 302-patient primary cohort, not the 50-case validation subset specifically) cannot be attributed to this specific dataset; has_outcome_data left false.
